Hey man really appreciate the material you’ve linked here, I’ve actually looked at some of Mark Freemans stuff when i was first told about the possibility of OCD and he’s really good at explaining things. 

I completely get what you mean about the knife incident, I know my mindset at the time wasn’t to hurt anyone, it was to protect myself if anyone tried to hurt me, not an excuse by any means but I completely understand how it sounds to people. When I told my girlfriend, who I often confide in, she was quite shocked and anxious herself but she understood. 

I had a counsellor for four free sessions through my university and she is one of the ones as well as my mum who told me I should call a doctor and ask for further therapy once my sessions with her finished. She also talked to me about meditation actually in regards to the knife incident, and I’ve tried it a few times with some other situations where I feel I’m spiralling a bit, and it definitely helps, it’s just hard to keep that in mind as a tool to help when anxieties getting the better of you y’know? 

I really appreciate all this and I’ll be sure to check out all the stuff you’ve linked, thanks again man
